verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Logseq ships a local HTTP API server. However, that server only exposes human-readable API documentation at 127.0.0.1:12315 and a single POST /api method-dispatch endpoint that refers to the community-driven plugin docs. The docs state explicitly that no OpenAPI document is published, and probes for openapi.json, swagger.json and well-known paths all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a downloadable machine-readable spec.
